2.14.14
Rectangle.Visibility
The Rectangle.Visibility element specifies whether a Rectangle is hidden. This element is optional
and is of type Visibility.
Following is the parent element of the Rectangle.Visibility element.
Parent elements
Rectangle
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Rectangle.Visibility element.
 <xsd:element name="Visibility" type="VisibilityType" minOccurs="0" />
